turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about Owen's essay. Why does he have a zero?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Flattery won't change what's in the gradebook. Owen's essay. Why the zero?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
That's your job, not mine, and it's not why I'm here. Owen's essay: who decided on the zero?
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. I'm not writing your emails, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
